items.title: Marty Sheller interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 9, 2022
items.q: That was composed by Pat Patrick and Rodgers Grant.

ctx.x: That was composed by Pat Patrick and Rodgers Grant. I’m not sure — I think Pat might have written the first part [scats], Rodgers wrote the bridge, it was moving chords,
moving up. But that became pretty popular. There was a guy Georgie Fame in England who I understand had a pretty nice hit with that song. A vocal version.
